meta.title: Prior art dataset - Datalink AI (ground-side datalink performance, AI diagnosis, certification tooling)

clusters.A: Aircraft datalink performance monitoring & ground-side aircraft data analytics
clusters.B: Aircraft datalink routing, link selection & communications management
clusters.C: AI/ML for wireless link prediction, interference and threat models
clusters.D: Certification / qualification / AI assurance (DO-178 / DO-254 / DO-330)
clusters.F: Pilot / crew response and human-factors monitoring

meta.disclaimer: Automated landscape screen, not a legal opinion. Legal status flags are machine-derived. Pending applications have a ~18-month blind window.

references.title: Systems and methods for aircraft datalink performance monitoring
references.disclosure: Ground-side real/near-real-time monitoring of CPDLC and ADS-C message exchanges; end-to-end performance defined by beginning/ending events; per-transmission-step tx/rx timestamps; comparison to mandated performance benchmarks (PBCS RCP 240 / RSP 180); identification of the transmission step that is the greatest cause of delay; NOC alerting; datalink reconfiguration (VHF <-> satellite); dashboard with ACTP/PORT breakdown; monitoring of pilot operational response time (PORT).
references.differentiation: No host-OS/platform telemetry attribution, no certification-evidence output, no AI advisory architecture, no learned threat models.
references.verification: Full text retrieved from Google Patents

references.title: Method for maintaining datalink network throughput by delaying lower priority messages
references.disclosure: Round-trip message time and channel occupancy measured by avionics software; low-priority messages delayed when congestion thresholds exceeded; implemented in a CMU / communication management function.
references.differentiation: Latency thresholding alone is old art.

references.title: Method for maintaining datalink network throughput by delaying lower priority messages
references.disclosure: System/CMF variant of the same family, explicitly deployed in ADS, airline operational communications and flight-deck communications functions.
references.differentiation: Same as US8045977B2.

references.title: Channel selection in aircraft communications system by determining zone load and selecting alternate carrier
references.disclosure: Selects preferred datalink channel/subnetwork (VHF/HF/SATCOM) using user-defined preference tables and zone load; dynamically reorders preferences based on communication status.
references.differentiation: Link selection by load/preference is anticipated.

references.title: Aircraft data link network routing
references.disclosure: Programmable message routing and network selection rules evaluated against aircraft state inputs; network selection and management function monitors and controls interfaces in a CMU; converged service interface with bandwidth allocation.
references.differentiation: No diagnosis, no attribution, no certification output.

references.title: Aircraft data link network routing (continuation)
references.disclosure: Continuation covering the converged service interface and dynamic bandwidth allocation.
references.differentiation: Same as US7729263B2.

references.title: Aircraft data link network routing (publication)
references.disclosure: Published routing application; early-priority citation.
references.differentiation: Same as US7729263B2.

references.title: Aircraft data link network routing (EP family)
references.disclosure: European family member for EP prosecution.
references.differentiation: Same as above.

references.title: Gatelink startup controlled by ACARS CMU
references.disclosure: CMU monitors its uplink for enable/disable gatelink signals; airport-list driven activation.
references.differentiation: CMU as monitoring point, but only for gatelink enablement.

references.title: Gatelink startup controlled by ACARS CMU (publication)
references.disclosure: Family includes CA2638509A1, US8107412B2.
references.differentiation: Same as above.

references.title: System and method for wireless routing of data from an aircraft
references.disclosure: Avionics communication system (CMU, terminal-area WLAN unit); QAR application sends recordings over the datalink to a ground server that evaluates them for events indicating significant deviation from normal operational parameters, detecting problems before an accident.
references.differentiation: Ground-side automated evaluation of downlinked data is old art.

references.title: Diagnostics for aircraft
references.disclosure: Automated acquisition and fleet-wide ground analysis of aircraft systems data to identify NON-PREDETERMINED troubleshooting procedures; ground support network as central repository; updated procedures redistributed to aircraft.
references.differentiation: Anticipates ground-server learning of new fault patterns with push-back; differentiate on what is pushed and how it is gated.

references.title: System and method of automated fault analysis and diagnostic testing of an aircraft
references.disclosure: Automated fault analysis and diagnostic testing of an aircraft.
references.differentiation: Background diagnostics art.

references.title: Aircraft data services
references.disclosure: Architecture for delivering aircraft data services including ground-side channel assignment.
references.differentiation: Background infrastructure art.

references.title: Correlation of flight track data with other data sources
references.disclosure: Ground system with ACARS receiver and decoder correlating ACARS data with Mode-S surveillance and airline data; self-learning database of correlations.
references.differentiation: Ground ACARS ingest + correlation is anticipated.

references.title: Aviation connectivity gateway module for remote data offload
references.disclosure: Connectivity gateway module managing remote offload of aircraft data across available links.
references.differentiation: Background gateway art.

references.title: Systems and methods for automatically recording interactivity and anomaly data at a vehicle
references.disclosure: Automatically records interactivity and anomaly data at a vehicle including crew interactions.
references.differentiation: Keep pilot-action analytics tied to datalink transaction attribution.

references.title: Emulating a vehicle-communications-center data request to obtain data from a system or subsystem onboard the vehicle
references.disclosure: Emulating a vehicle communications centre data request to pull onboard subsystem data to the ground.
references.differentiation: Argue bidirectional performance correlation as the technical difference.

references.title: Aviation datalink communications management unit
references.disclosure: CMU/flight-deck interface device with ATC menu, LINK TEST function for ACARS/AVLC connectivity, SYSTEM MON page (tuned frequency, status), FAULTS page listing current faults.
references.differentiation: CMU link test + fault list is anticipated; novelty must be automated cross-layer correlation and certification output.

references.title: Analysing tactical data link messages
references.disclosure: Ground tool storing, grouping, tabulating and filtering data link messages by type/field to expose erroneous or unusual content and interoperability conflicts.
references.differentiation: Rule/database datalink message analysis is anticipated.

references.title: Airborne ACARS and malfunction diagnosis and health management method thereof
references.disclosure: Airborne ACARS with communication unit, communication management unit and integrated modular avionics; method for malfunction diagnosis and health management of the ACARS system.
references.differentiation: Direct hit on CMU/ACARS fault diagnosis; differentiate on ground-side attribution + certification evidence.

references.title: Airborne network security event processing system and processing method thereof
references.disclosure: Airborne security log analysis system monitoring security events, diagnosing severity and generating isolation control signals.
references.differentiation: Very recent; monitor family expansion.

references.title: Detection of cyber attacks targeting avionics systems
references.disclosure: Detection of cyber attacks targeting avionics systems (WO20202019918).
references.differentiation: Core avionics intrusion-detection art; our angle is ground-learned threat models pushed to air with certification gating.

references.title: Interference suppression using machine learning
references.disclosure: Trained ML model extracts jammer and noise components from a received RF signal and outputs a cleaned signal; trained on simulated combinations of jammers including GPS jamming.
references.differentiation: Differentiate: ground-learned signature libraries distributed as advisory threat models, not in-line suppression.

references.title: Adaptive transmission and transmission path selection based on predicted channel state
references.disclosure: ML model predicts a future wireless channel state from weights and current/previous states; transmission parameters and paths are selected accordingly.
references.differentiation: Generic ML link-state prediction is anticipated; only an aviation-certification-specific variant is defensible.

references.title: System and method for connecting aircraft to networks on ground
references.disclosure: Onboard core network with a gateway switching among wireless/optical/wired/crew wireless links to ground networks.
references.differentiation: Make link re-selection claims dependent on the attribution output.

references.title: Systems and methods for cognitive services of a connected FMS or avionics SaaS platform
references.disclosure: Cloud/SaaS avionics platform that trains reinforcement-learning models on training data and serves them to a connected FMS/avionics.
references.differentiation: Anticipates cloud-trained ML served to avionics; differentiate with certification gating and a non-adaptive airborne partition.

references.title: Analysis of aircraft trajectories
references.disclosure: Vectorises aircraft trajectories into enumerator sequences, aligns them and detects anomalies by unsupervised classification; onboard or ground implementation with anomaly communication to ground stations.
references.differentiation: Narrow our ML to link/OS telemetry attribution.

references.title: Systems and methods of intelligent weather sensing using deep learning
references.disclosure: Weather radar with RF receiver, entity detector and a machine-learning circuit.
references.differentiation: Not overlapping; evidence that ML-in-avionics claims are grantable.

references.title: Methods, apparatus and systems for enhanced synthetic vision and multi-sensor data fusion for UAV operation with multiple data links
references.disclosure: Multiple data links between UAV and control station for control and actionable intelligence data.
references.differentiation: Multi-link management prior art.

references.title: Apparatus and method for qualifying data automatically generated from an unqualified system
references.disclosure: Receives data automatically generated in an unqualified system that controls or obtains data from a vehicle management system; verifies integrity of the data; if verified, qualifies the data; provides qualified data to a qualified system in the vehicle management system.
references.differentiation: Foundational for certifiable-AI-output claims; our integrity verification must use OOD/uncertainty/robustness envelope checks plus an objective-linked evidence bundle.
references.verification: Full text retrieved from Google Patents

references.title: Apparatus and method for qualifying data automatically generated from an unqualified system (granted)
references.disclosure: Granted claims of the US20180211261A1 disclosure.
references.differentiation: Same as above.
references.verification: Full text retrieved from Google Patents

references.title: Tool verification system and method of verifying an unqualified component
references.disclosure: Receives communications between a tool and an unverified component, compares the communications with a previously-qualified set of communications, and determines whether the unqualified component can be passed.
references.differentiation: Anticipates reference-comparison qualification; use a different verification basis.

references.title: Tool verification system and method of verifying an unqualified component (CN family)
references.disclosure: Chinese family member of EP3651022A1.
references.differentiation: Same as above; relevant for CN prosecution.

references.title: Systems and methods for program code defect and acceptability for use within certification
references.disclosure: Code development engine evaluates build code to identify and correct coding errors; run-time simulation engine evaluates acceptability of code for use within a certification framework.
references.differentiation: Our toolchain claim must be ML-component specific (learning assurance, data qualification, behavioural evidence).

references.title: Generating result explanations for neural networks
references.disclosure: Trains an unexplainable model and an explainable surrogate model on the same data; on query, compares their outputs and returns the explainable model's decision path as the explanation.
references.differentiation: Do not claim generic surrogate explanation; claim certification-objective-linked explanation artifacts.

references.title: Systems and methods for safe and reliable autonomous vehicles
references.disclosure: Vehicle controller with hierarchically interconnected behaviour, lane and route planners plus a behaviour selector executing on deep-learning accelerators.
references.differentiation: Differentiate with an explicit untrusted-advisory vs certified-deterministic split plus runtime monitor and rollback tied to datalink diagnostics.

references.title: Aircraft systems and methods for monitoring onboard communications
references.disclosure: Identifies a functional change to an onboard avionics system, determines an expected pilot callout from rules, monitors an audio input device for the expected callout, and generates a notification when the expected pilot response is absent within a threshold time.
references.differentiation: Add the causal link to a datalink transaction and the PORT/human-factors attribution output.

references.title: Aircraft uplink message response prompt
references.disclosure: Prompts the operator to reply to a datalink (CPDLC) uplink before a timer expires; tracks uplink message state, downlink response input and timer expiry.
references.differentiation: Compute PORT-style distributions and attribute delay between human and technical causes with an evidence output.

references.title: System and method for crowd sourcing aircraft data communications
references.disclosure: Crowd-sourcing of aircraft data communications; fleet-sourced aggregation.
references.differentiation: Claim federated learning with certification gating and per-aircraft model governance.

references.title: Method and system for vehicle software management
references.disclosure: Remote monitoring and diagnostics plus software management across vehicle subsystems; explicitly lists a communication management unit.
references.differentiation: Push back advisory data only, not airborne software change.

references.title: Method for aggregating system integrity management information on an aircraft
references.disclosure: Aggregates system integrity management information across aircraft LRUs including a communication management unit.
references.differentiation: CMU health data aggregation is old art.

references.title: Systems and methods for detecting and representing traffic maneuvers on a display
references.disclosure: Traffic maneuver detection and display; mentions improved pilot response time as a benefit.
references.differentiation: Background only.

references.title: System and method for atmospheric air density anomaly sensing using refraction
references.disclosure: Time-synchronised ground-node / satellite-constellation sensing of atmospheric anomalies via refraction.
references.differentiation: Background on ground-network + aircraft timing techniques.
